blocks.x: Adam Blevins began working in the entertainment industry in 2022 as a Staff Writer for Agents of Fandom, where he progressed to Senior Editor and interviewed talent from Marvel Studios, House of the Dragon, and Planet of the Apes. He joined Collider as a News Author in April 2024, was promoted to a Senior position in December 2024, and has written over 3,000 articles for the site, including exclusives relating to Avengers: Doomsday, The Penguin, Star Wars: Skeleton Crew, and more. He primarily writes about the latest box office numbers and the hottest movies and TV shows on streaming, while also covering superhero and sci-fi news. He has completed a set visit for The Chosen and even has several months of experience writing Gaming Features at ScreenRant. You can find him on X, LinkedIn, and Muckrack.

When it comes to crime thriller shows on streaming, very few titles have the same claim to fame as the Bosch franchise, starring the great Titus Welliver. Welliver played Bosch for years on Prime Video, first in Bosch and later in Bosch: Legacy, and although both shows are off the air for now, he’s still set to return in the second season of Ballard, which will likely premiere on Prime Video before the end of this year. Bosch is based on the legendary series of crime novels from author Michael Connelly, who is also famous for writing another series of books that have been adapted into both film and television. We’re talking, of course, about The Lincoln Lawyer, which was first told in live-action via a Matthew McConaughey-starring film before Netflix nabbed the rights and turned it into a series.

The Lincoln Lawyer and Bosch are two entirely different shows, but fans of one are likely to appreciate the other thanks to the similarities and nuances in Michael Connelly’s writing. Netflix has released four full seasons of The Lincoln Lawyer to date, and while the show has been officially renewed for Season 5, there’s a catch. Not long after The Lincoln Lawyer was renewed for Season 5, Netflix confirmed in a shocking announcement that it would be the final season of the show. This was met with pushback from fans, who felt the show has the potential to stay on the air for years, especially with its strong viewership. Netflix has all but confirmed that The Lincoln Lawyer Season 5 will premiere before the end of this year, but that won’t be the end of the story.
